NgraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale:
F134.2 shrunk the discard charter to two requirements: fold inside the verb, and document that supersede discards governance never code. The spec is those two. The layer, the no-epoch skip, and the borrowed terminal are the decisions that make the first requirement implementable without a new kind.
Rename already preserves run/. The HEAD probe archived run/1-T-001-opened.xml. The defect is not that files vanish on renameSync; it is that the durable instrument (Epoch, attempts, status.epochCount) is not written. C-SUPERSEDE-VERB's absent run/ is a revert artifact, not proof that supersede deletes loose events. Folding before the move is still required: archive measurements read Epoch-N, not leftover run/ files.
The brief's "exit 0, silently" for unterminated fold is false at this HEAD: exit 1, stderr "unterminated range for w0". F131's "exited 0" for the no-events message is also false today (C-PHASE-RULE-PIN and C-SUPERSEDE-VERB both exit 1). The spec uses the measured refuse, not the brief's recollection.

Alternatives.Alternative: Fold only in the CLI handler (src/grace-supersede.ts:72-95). Leaves supersedeChangeBundle as a write+rename helper. The EXDEV test would not fold, which is convenient, and the comment "Command-path only" would stay literally true. Rejected: F133. The product verb has two callers; a mechanism at the handler does not reach the function the tests and any future caller use. The CLI already only delegates.

Relax fold's terminal check when the caller is supersede, and fold an unterminated range. Avoids emitting a kind whose skill text says "the epoch's work is finished". Rejected: grammar validates the written Epoch with the same terminal requirement (ledger.range-unterminated). Fold verify would fail unless grammar changed too. Two invariants versus emitting one existing kind. F134.2 already measured that no consumer claims completion.
Document only in ngrace-cli. Rejected: ngrace-cli's shape_sources says the live inventory is the README table bound to listLiveInvocations, and forbids restating it there.

Skip skill-text edits and change only meta.description and README. Smaller blast radius (no token-accounting pin). Rejected for the agent readers: plan and execute are the surfaces that tell an agent to run the verb. --help is not. F133 still applies: a skill edit forces the byte pin, so those files are named in the spec rather than discovered at execution.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: Effort accounting. The bundle after that.
State: complete naming on an abandoned bundle. F134.2 nit.
